facts_raw.Program: Mediobanca & Founders Factory Fintech Investment Program
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Current page does not publicly summarize fixed equity terms
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 全球 fintech founder；项目主题需落在六大金融科技方向之一。当前 accelerator 为 Milan & Remote。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 已有可 pilot 的产品；能对接银行/资管/贷款/合规业务线；pre-seed–Series A 更匹配。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 官方页面写 Milan & Remote；4个月 accelerator。不是全程强制 on-site，但 Milan 企业合作和展示节点价值高。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Current page lists February 6 application close for listed cohort
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Fintech，尤其 wealth management、corporate/investment banking、consumer lending、insurtech、legaltech、compliance/audit/risk；希望进入意大利/欧洲金融机构的团队。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 非金融科技；没有 enterprise financial use case；无法从 Mediobanca 商业场景中获益。
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：欧洲 fintech/enterprise distribution 很有价值；非 fintech 不应推荐。

facts.Program: Mediobanca & Founders Factory Fintech Investment Program
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Current page does not publicly summarize fixed equity terms
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Global fintech founders matching one of six focus areas. The current program is based in Milan and remote.
facts.Strong-to-Have: A pilot-ready product for banking, asset management, lending or compliance, ideally pre-seed to Series A.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Four months, Milan and remote. Full-time attendance is not required, but Milan corporate meetings and showcases are valuable.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Current page lists February 6 application close for listed cohort
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Fintech teams seeking Italian or European financial customers, especially in wealth management, banking, lending, insurance, legal technology, compliance, audit or risk.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Non-fintech companies without enterprise financial use cases or limited benefit from Mediobanca's commercial network.
facts.Notes: Strong European fintech and enterprise distribution value; not a general-purpose program for non-fintech companies.
